products.product_description: Peaches, sold as a bulk retail item, with PLU 4044, and country of origin of Chile. The peaches sold at Aldi are packaged in a two pound bag with the brand Rio Duero, EAN# 7804650090281.

products.product_description: Nectarines sold as a bulk retail item, with PLU 3035 (white flesh nectarine) and 4378 (yellow flesh nectarine), and country of origin of Chile. The nectarines sold at Costco are packaged in a 4-pound plastic clamshell with the brand Rio Duero, EAN# 7804650090212.
